Every route step says what to do, what can kill you and when to stop; the badge shows headline and with-prep together (template dsBadge; DP badges too); Q-01/Q-02 are disclosed in the intro; S05 Iban temple gate (48/48, Protect from Melee does not block spikes, stun -> eat to full, two-stun stop) is on card and prose; S17 has Protect from Melee on the run and states the run window cannot be closed (S17-M4, prose warning 1). FAIL: S12's rendered 'Why this step' text (plan.json S12 rationale, shown by the template) still says 'do not wear the escape crystal in the duel ...; if carried, keep it in the inventory only', which contradicts the corrected card ('BANK it', stop condition: never enter with the crystal worn or in the inventory). The owner reads two opposite instructions on the highest with-prep step of the Balanced route; following the rationale recreates the RT-16 reset loop through run-ending forms 1-3.

No open critical/high (RT-01..RT-04 fixed). RT-16 (low, open): the S12 risk card is fixed (S12-M6, required_items, stop_conditions[0], bailout, prose instructions[5] and warnings[1], and the general risk rule's Koschei exception all say bank the crystal), but it is NOT effectively resolved in the shipped guide because the S12 rationale still says to carry it (see check 6). Accepted risks: S05, S06, S12, S16, S17 have accept_risk entries (seq 123-126, 159, 160). RT-05, RT-07 and RT-15 are marked accepted_by_user but have no accept_risk entry; the red team cites the owner's ladder approval (calibration-20261120 seq 16, 23:23 UTC) and tier decision (seq 17, 23:27), both made before those findings existed (red-team 034, 23:43). RT-17 (low, docs/CLI labels) open, non-blocking.

reasons: R1 (check 6/7, owner safety): S12 'Why this step' (plan.json steps S12 rationale, rendered by the template) says 'if carried, keep it [the escape crystal] in the inventory only', contradicting the corrected S12 card, which says BANK it before the Koschei duel. RT-16 is therefore not effectively resolved in the guide the owner reads. Fix: route-strategist text-only edit of the S12 rationale to match the card (bank the escape crystal before the duel; never a ring of life), then re-assemble; a red-team re-test of RT-16 or QA re-check closes it.

R2 (check 7, charter: every accepted risk has a ledger accept_risk entry): RT-05, RT-07 and RT-15 are marked accepted_by_user without accept_risk entries; the owner approvals cited predate the findings. Fix: Director asks the owner about these three ladder findings and records the answers verbatim with accept_risk, or routes them back as open (none affects a route step: no step enters the Wilderness, and the compression over-states rather than under-states mid-band scores).

Not blocking, fix in the same pass if possible: tools/assemble.py does not ship 39 cited fact IDs (e.g. F-5010 on S12-H1, F-0003/F-3012 random-event deaths), so their links in the guide are dead. This is a governance change for the Director.
